children: Bristol Myers Squibb said the Food and Drug Administration approved Camzyos to treat symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in adults and pediatric patients weighing more than 66 pounds.
Symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is a genetic condition that causes thickening of heart muscles, which can block blood flow.

The new indication offers a new treatment option for patients with significant unmet need, the company said, adding Camzyos is the only FDA-approved treatment for pediatric patients with the condition.
Bristol Myers Squibb also said pediatric data are being discussed with several global regulatory authorities with an eye toward potential pediatric indications.
